stem: What is the most likely reason the author includes this photograph?
instruction:
Use “Dive into a Sunken Museum” to answer the following question.

options.label: A

options.label: B

options.label: C
options.text: To show how Jason Taylor’s underwater parks lead people away from nearby reefs
